development_history: Defined after inspecting E3 timing results and while E3 main was executing. E3 timing showed zero harmful selections. No E3b outcomes had been computed. This is an exploratory mechanism check, not a preregistered primary hypothesis.
hypothesis: Paired mixtures with the same weak and strong parent may shield worse candidates through within-family ordering. Evaluate all six libraries with one candidate from each family and both validation target signs present.
seed_rule: Reuse exactly the 400 E3 main logs. No additional independent logs. All six libraries reported; no selection based on evaluation values.
methods: All thirteen E2/E3 rules and all conditions. Recompute union bound with M=3 rather than M=6. This change is disclosed; point-estimate rules isolate policy-set effects without confidence changes.
grid: Unchanged E3 n/gamma/epsilon grid, alpha, attack algorithm and limits.
analysis: Report each library and all 72 library-by-grid cells. Primary E3 findings remain separate. Aggregate weights all libraries and cells equally. Paired bootstrap over 100 seed clusters; unresolved attack gaps retained.
compute: Four processes; sixteen 25-seed shards per library; eight timing logs per library before main.
